marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 7. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 This week's showcase reveals various methods used to attract attention through food and restaurant decoration, becoming a focal point for city dwellers enjoying various types of cuisine. A maritime-themed restaurant located in Kampung Baru attracts the public to dine on the diverse menus provided. SEGMENT 2 Checking out a mini zoo that houses various species of birds and exotic animals provides a brand new experience. This animal conservation center has been designed to offer an interactive experience between visitors and the animals, which will be shown to you shortly. SEGMENT 3 A creative idea using discarded VCDs as a safety measure for children playing outside the house, which has become a new way to catch the public's attention to be careful when entering the village area.
